title: An orbit camera
description:
Work out a 3D camera position that orbits a target.

```
target (0, 0, 0), distance 10, yaw 0, pitch 30
-> camera at (0.00, 5.00, 8.66)
yaw 90 -> (8.66, 5.00, 0.00)
pitch is kept between -89 and 89
```
hints: `x = cos(pitch) * sin(yaw)`, `y = sin(pitch)`, `z = cos(pitch) * cos(yaw)`, times the distance, plus the target (lesson 5.02).
requirements: `struct Vector3 { float x, y, z; }` with `+`, `-` and `*` by a number.
The position from spherical angles in degrees.
Clamp the pitch so the camera never flips over the top.
stretch: Zoom with the mouse wheel, keeping the distance between 2 and 50.
